text.value: The road welcomed you as an envoy. Why have you arrived armed?
You are standing on Marrow-Aunt Sefla, who mended wells. Beside her lie her sons. Every name here is a candle, stranger, and I have kept them lit longer than your country has had a name.
Turn back through the gate. It will cost you nothing; the ledger forgives what does not happen.
So. You heard the whole of the warning, and you raise the bow regardless. Then watch my hands, envoy — the law requires that I show you where every blow will fall, and I have never once broken it.

notes: Authored in-session by the game-dev agent at user direction (the studio's claude-cli provider is blocked by an org 403 on headless auth). Honors the brief: mercy offered (l3), weakness never revealed, fair-warning law stated (l4), remembrance-not-necromancy flavor, no book revelation. Review or regenerate in studio at will.
